reader_summary.overview: In this episode, Tano Santos sits down with Jan Hummel, CIO of Paradigm Capital. Jan discusses the foundational investment philosophy of Paradigm Capital, emphasizing risk minimization and the strategic deployment of assets across Europe. Key discussions pivot around the firm's selective investment criteria.

key_points.text: In this episode, Tano Santos sits down with Jan Hummel, CIO of Paradigm Capital.
Key discussions pivot around the firm's selective investment criteria.
This conversation offers listeners insights into the subtleties of value investing, portfolio construction, the implications of geopolitical and economic dynamics on market opportunities.
